# Angel Ade-Oduntan

> Operations strategist and UC Berkeley Haas MBA (Class of 2027). Redesigning how operations create value at scale in infrastructure-intensive businesses. Six years across power, telecom, industrial, banking, and payments.

This site has a human view (visual portfolio) and a machine view (Markdown). Every page is available as Markdown at the links below, or by toggling the Human/Machine switch on any page, or by appending `?view=machine` to its URL.

## Pages

- [Home](/index.md): Profile, capabilities, experience, education, case studies, contact
- [About](/about.md): Longer narrative — background, approach, and personal interests
- [Writing](/writing.md): Essays on operations strategy and AI in the workflow (in progress)
- [Selected Work](/selected-work.md): Personal projects and experiments (in progress)
